title: Color / Full palette — RGB specifications

location.series: IBM Design Language / alternate tab states
location.label: RGB

slide_intent: Translate a named palette into reproducible screen values, because recognizable color needs a specification as well as a visual example.
strategic_value: A shared RGB reference can help IBM teams preserve the same named colors across digital assets.
demonstration: The RGB tab pairs color names and numbered grades with red, green and blue channel values across seven hue families and three gray families.
practical_value: Look up a color by its family and grade when implementing an RGB digital asset.

content_islands.name: Encoding selector
content_islands.spec: Keep the HEX, RGB, PMS and CMYK tabs above the table, with RGB selected.

content_islands.name: Hue families
content_islands.spec: Arrange red, magenta, purple, blue, cyan, teal and green as dark-to-light named swatch columns.

content_islands.name: Neutral families
content_islands.spec: Place cool gray, gray and warm gray columns beneath the hues, each bounded by black and white.

reference_purposes.Expression: The complete swatch arrangement shows the range and tonal organization of IBM’s palette.
reference_purposes.Application: Each named grade is paired with its RGB channels; Blue 60, for example, reads r 15 g 98 b 254.
